fields.Name: TestRunTotalsByTest
fields.UserQuestion: For each test that ran in a time window, how many runs passed or failed, what did they cost, and how long did they take?
fields.Description: One row per test that ran between start and end: run count, passed count, failures (Failed or Error), skipped count, total cost, and average and maximum duration of completed runs. Feeds the Testing dashboard's analytics, which rates executed (non-skipped) runs only.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups vwTestRuns joined to vwTests by TestID, test Name and test Type for runs whose StartedAt is in [start, end] ({{ start | sqlDate }}, {{ end | sqlDate }}). Failures = Failed + Error. Skipped = Skipped runs (not executed; excluded from the dashboard's rate denominators). TotalCost sums CostUSD (NULL as 0). AvgDurationMs/MaxDurationMs use DATEDIFF_BIG(millisecond, StartedAt, CompletedAt), NULL for runs not completed.

fields.Name: start
fields.Description: Inclusive lower bound on the run's StartedAt (ISO timestamp).

fields.Name: end
fields.Description: Inclusive upper bound on the run's StartedAt (ISO timestamp).
